rules.name: QAG3 A01 - Start Epic on Task delivery
QAG3 A02 - Ready Epic for acceptance
QAG3 A03 - Reopen Epic on approved Task change
rules.description: QAG3 only. Created or transitioned non-Done Task with qag3-scope-approved marker reopens REVIEW/Done Epic; never restores CANCELLED or accepts Done. Scope marker is business approval metadata, not an authorization control. Enabled for QAG3 simulation after targeted native qualification; authenticated PM and data validators remain enforced.

rules.name: QAG3 A04 - Reconcile old and new Epic after Parent change
rules.description: QAG3 only. Actor follows the user who triggered the event; no static admin delegation. Approved Task Parent change reconciles old/new Epic. Never auto-Done, Cancel or Restore; old Done Epic is preserved. Existing PM and data validators still apply; unauthorized transitions fail. Enabled for QAG3 simulation after targeted native qualification. Current-scope checks and re-fetch are not atomic.

rules.name: QAG3 A05 - Notify independent PM review coordinator
rules.description: QAG3 only; full QAG3 simulation scope. Posts a review coordination comment mentioning the other PM, not QA approval or acceptance evidence. Frozen event/status, re-fetch, preserved labels and per-event attempt marker reduce replay; not atomic exactly-once delivery. Native issue-once comment guard is OFF so later review events can notify again. Failure retains marker for manual audit. Email replaced by owner-approved Jira comments; no privacy or billing changes.
